<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5><COL FEEB4EFF>Deep in the <COL FEEB4EFF>Surbi Dunes</COL> where <COL FEEB4EFF>Melynx</COL> stand,
there were traces of trees.

<MWT 4>I searched deeper for supplies,
but all were tainted by poison.

<MWT 4>This poison is natural —
long ago this must have been
a poison forest...
